html_source: An American three-masted schooner named HMS Bounty, which sank off the coast of North Carolina in October 2012, during Hurricane Sandy. Most schooners are fore-and-aft rigged, but it seems that Stephen is seeing a square-rigged one such as this. Source: www.bob-owens.com.
